breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction that end slopes are zero. Instead, it correctly identifies that the mid-span slope is zero (by symmetry) and treats the slope at x=0 as an unknown to be determined. This aligns with the ground truth, which simply asks to compute the slope at the left support without imposing any incorrect zero-slope constraint at the supports.
